name: nexus-rebalanced
title: Nexus Rebalanced
author: Alex Green
description: Balance for Nexus Extended Promethium Endgame: the prices of 1.3.0 eased, beacons on the machines of Nexus, a faster omega lab, the zero-point energy engine core limited by its own quality, the warp drive only on the way to the Oort cloud and Sol, storms that calm down and a shield that regenerates outside storms. For Nexus 1.3.6 or newer; Nexus-Updated (the 2.1 fork) works too.
